notes: Tutorial keymap (docs/TUTORIAL-CLI.md, 'shortcut' section): swaps just 2 keys, for either US or JIS boards. Calibrate with --calibrate-simple <UniqIdHex> 2, pressing (1) CapsLock (on JIS: the 'Caps Lock / 英数' key), then (2) Left Ctrl. Position 0 (CapsLock / Eisu) = KC_LCTRL, position 1 (Left Ctrl) = KC_CAPSLOCK. Keys that are not in the layer map pass through unchanged, so there is no need to calibrate the whole keyboard for a simple swap.
